name: artillery-onboarding-example
description: Onboarding example project for Artillery load and stress testing against a Node.js server.

scripts.test:load: mkdir -p reports && TARGET_URL=${TARGET_URL:-http://localhost:2929} artillery run tests/performance/load.yml --output reports/load.json
scripts.test:stress: mkdir -p reports && TARGET_URL=${TARGET_URL:-http://localhost:2929} artillery run tests/performance/stress.yml --output reports/stress.json
scripts.test:spike: mkdir -p reports && TARGET_URL=${TARGET_URL:-http://localhost:2929} artillery run tests/performance/spike.yml --output reports/spike.json
scripts.test:soak: mkdir -p reports && TARGET_URL=${TARGET_URL:-http://localhost:2929} artillery run tests/performance/soak.yml --output reports/soak.json
scripts.test:websocket: mkdir -p reports && WS_TARGET_URL=${WS_TARGET_URL:-ws://localhost:2929} artillery run tests/performance/websocket.yml --output reports/websocket.json
scripts.test:socketio: mkdir -p reports && TARGET_URL=${TARGET_URL:-http://localhost:2929} artillery run tests/performance/socketio.yml --output reports/socketio.json
scripts.report:load: pnpm dlx artillery@2.0.21 report reports/load.json --output reports/load.html
scripts.report:stress: pnpm dlx artillery@2.0.21 report reports/stress.json --output reports/stress.html
scripts.report:spike: pnpm dlx artillery@2.0.21 report reports/spike.json --output reports/spike.html
scripts.report:soak: pnpm dlx artillery@2.0.21 report reports/soak.json --output reports/soak.html
